trials.failure_mechanism_note: GAP-04 is an exploratory hypothesis about a broader KRAS G12/13 plus TP53 subgroup in an MSS-CRC proxy cohort (TCGA COAD, resected tumors). It does not explain KRYSTAL-10's outcome and does not establish comparative benefit for daraxonrasib. The proximate causes of KRYSTAL-10 failure are: feedback reactivation via EGFR/RTK, cetuximab backbone contraindicated in RAS-mutant CRC, and OS confounding by crossover.
trials.status_note: ClinicalTrials.gov API status: ACTIVE_NOT_RECRUITING (enrollment closed, follow-up ongoing). Primary endpoint failure reported at ESMO GI 2026 (July 3, 2026). Both descriptions are accurate.
